title: A Russian to-do for tomorrow lands on today
brief: A hero reports: in Russian, the command «задача на завтра: купить тетрадь» puts the to-do on TODAY, while the English «todo tomorrow: buy a notebook» works. Reproduce it with a test (or find the existing test that fails), find the cause in the code, and report it. Do not change index.html.
